_comment: What's next / À surveiller. Only dates stated in a cited source. date: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY; kind: on (happens that day), by (deadline: by that date), year (sometime that year). The page script moves an item to 'Past' the day after its date (end of year for kind=year), so no rebuild is needed. pages: 'home' and/or dossier ids. Validate with `python3 _tools/plain.py --strict`.
